text: At 2:17 one Wednesday morning in Maybrook, Pennsylvania, [seventeen children run from their homes and vanish|trigger|someone goes missing], all from Justine Gandy's third-grade class except a boy named Alex Lilly. Blamed by the parents and placed on leave, Justine follows Alex home to [a house with newspaper over its windows|images|the house and its rooms] and his parents sitting motionless inside. [Archer Graff, a father of one of the missing|who_suffers|the grieving], traces the children's paths on doorbell footage, while both are plagued by nightmares of [a mysterious elderly woman|threat|witchcraft and cursed things].
